items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I used to play with him too. Emily's cousin, Earl Foster.

ctx.x: Yeah. I used to play with him too. Emily's cousin, Earl Foster. You never heard of him, eh? Yeah, I know him. That's Anderson's cousin. Yeah. That's a funny story to hear. Tell it, you know. Yeah, after he came up there that night to get me, you know.
Yeah, but he wasn't doing nothing.
